dedupe_keys.name: a harmonized dataset of high resolution embodied life cycle assessment results for buildings in north america

description: A Harmonized Dataset of High-Resolution Embodied Life Cycle Assessment Results for Buildings in North America is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Brad Benke et al. Building design practitioners are increasingly using life cycle assessment (LCA) to assess the environmental impacts of their buildings. However, industry-generated LCA results are rarely compiled into comparable datasets and rarely made public. Thus, harmonized and open-access datasets of building LCA results are limited, particularly in North America. Coverage: continental; published in 2025. Formats: Excel. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 104775829 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
